prompt: Revise the long-winded paragraph in the workspace file `longwinded-paragraph.txt` into exactly two concise sentences.
prompt_addendum: Save the revision as revised.txt in the workspace.

gate.note: structural stage (this check): exactly 2 sentences, materially shorter than the input. Judged stage (full runs): meaning preserved, scored against gold/rubric. The input artifact deliberately contains no abbreviations or decimal points, so naive sentence splitting is sound.
